# PAZU World

> > PAZU World is a collection of ad-free, family-friendly mobile games for kids featuring creative gameplay like cooking, pet care, and character customization across iOS and Android.

PAZU World offers a curated portfolio of casual games designed for preschool through early elementary-aged children, with a focus on creative simulation games and dress-up gameplay. The platform emphasizes offline play, multi-device support, and ad-free experiences through the Pazu+ subscription service.

## Core Platform

- [PAZU World Homepage](https://pazugames.com): PAZU World homepage showcasing mobile games for kids including Avatar World, Making Pizza, and more.
- [About PAZU](https://pazugames.com/about): About PAZU: company mission, Pazu+ subscription, and mobile games on Apple and Android.
- [PAZU Products](https://pazugames.com/product): PAZU product overview: ad-free family games with offline play and multi-device support.

## Character & Customization Games

- [Avatar World](https://pazugames.com/games/55): Avatar World: character creation and avatar customization game for kids.
- [My Unicorn](https://pazugames.com/games/26): My Unicorn: dress-up and pet care game with character customization.
- [Chic Baby](https://pazugames.com/games/0): Chic Baby: dress-up and baby care game for ages 3-6.

## Beauty & Fashion Games

- [Girls Hair Salon](https://pazugames.com/games/5): Girls Hair Salon: hairstyle creator and styling simulation for fashion-loving kids.
- [Girls Nail Salon](https://pazugames.com/games/27): Girls Nail Salon: creative nail art and manicure simulation game.
- [Unicorn Hairstyling](https://pazugames.com/games/12): Unicorn hairstyling and hair salon game for girls.

## Cooking & Food Games

- [Making Pizza](https://pazugames.com/games/24): Making Pizza: cooking simulation game for preschool and kindergarten learners.
- [Sushi Maker](https://pazugames.com/games/54): Sushi Maker: Japanese cooking game with mini-games for kids.
- [Cooking Masters](https://pazugames.com/games/40): Cooking Masters: bakery and dessert-making simulation with recipe gameplay.

## Pet & Care Games

- [Virtual Pet Care](https://pazugames.com/games/57): Virtual pet care game with animal adoption and mini-games for families.
- [Pet Doctor](https://pazugames.com/games/28): Pet doctor veterinary simulation with animal treatment and healing gameplay.
- [Jungle Animal Care](https://pazugames.com/games/7): Jungle animal care and veterinary simulation game with healing gameplay.
- [Childcare Simulator](https://pazugames.com/games/29): Childcare simulator and babysitting game for family-friendly casual gameplay.

## Support & Help

- [PAZU Support Center](https://pazugames.com/support): Support center for PAZU games with FAQ, help, contact, account and subscription support.
